title: Limits and Levels Callbacks: Distance to the Limit Review Decision on a Personal Sender Account
content:
**Rule.** For a callback on limits and levels to the holder of a Personal Sender Account, the distance to the review decision is the number of calendar days from the callback request date to the decision due date of the account's most recent limit review request. When it is 14 days or more, 2 business days are added to the counted limits callback window; when it is at least 7 but fewer than 14 days, 1 business day is added to the counted limits callback window; when it is fewer than 7 days, or that decision due date is on or before the callback request date, nothing is added for the distance to the review decision.

## Reading the records

The account's limit review requests appear on its account history, each with the date it was lodged and its decision due date. The most recent limit review request is the one lodged last; its decision due date is the one compared with the callback request date.

## Tiers on both sides

| Decision due date of the most recent limit review request | Business days added |
|---|---|
| 14 or more calendar days after the callback request date | 2 |
| exactly 13 calendar days after | 1 |
| exactly 7 calendar days after | 1 |
| exactly 6 calendar days after | 0 |
| on the callback request date, or before it | 0 |
| the account history shows no limit review request | 0 |

## Hypothetical example

A callback on limits and levels is requested on 3 November. The account's most recent limit review request carries a decision due date of 17 November: 14 calendar days ahead, so 2 business days are added. Had the decision due date been 12 November (9 days ahead), 1 business day would be added; had it been 3 November or earlier, none.
